item.title: Israeli airstrikes, shelling and building demolitions reported across southern Lebanon on 19-20 Nov, including Qantara, Shaara, Haddatha, Kfar Tebnit, Kounine and Zawtar al-Sharqiya
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Lebanon. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces. Disputed or caveats: Daily tallies relayed by Drop Site News on X and party-affiliated channels; no casualty figures reported. 7 sources.
